question: Are there alternative treatments of this word (other differences, input-difference absorption, other values)?
number: (w10,w11) with the same D1 outputs: exactly one pair per (S1,S12) input choice. A difference in D1 inputs S1 and/or S12 between A and B is absorbed exactly by (w10,w11): S1 and S12 both differ 100000/100000, S1 only 100000/100000, S12 only 100000/100000 (outputs X1,X6,X11,X12 equal). Differences in S6 or S11 cannot be absorbed: b1,c1,d1 are fixed by the outputs, so S6 = ROL(b1,12)^c1 and S11 = c1-d1 are forced equal (100000/100000). The route is closed: S12 is a function of (S4,S8) at K0 for any counter/flags (200000/200000), so an S12-only difference cannot arise; S12 differing means S4,S8 differ, and S4 (D3 input) and S8 (D2 input) have no absorbing words in this layout (w14=w15=0, w13=W13 pinned).
